name: devbook-derived
description: The devbook tooling: the checker and generator over devbook's addressed Markdown chapters, in one plugin. build.mjs parses every meta block, resolves every reference, and writes the derived _meta/ indexes — the reference graph, the reading outline, and the open-note index — per adopted folder and for the repository; --check validates and writes nothing, --print emits the same documents on stdout. Ships annotations.mjs, the only writer of an annotation fence; the devbook-graph canvas that renders the graph from the same modules; the CI check and nightly refresh workflows; the on-demand refresh script; and the derived-artifacts rule. Four skills: install materializes all of it into a repository under .devbook/_tools/ and stamps components.derived; check runs the checker and reads devbook's ledger and stamp for drift; annotation-sweep deletes resolved fences; tech-update refreshes a .tech graph from the package inventory scripts. An L1 extension over devbook, which names nothing here: devbook is the convention, this is what enforces and derives from it.
